title: Cards Sorting
statementMd:
Vasily has a deck of cards consisting of $*n*$ cards. There is an integer on each of the cards, this integer is between $1$ and $100 000$, inclusive. It is possible that some cards have the same integers on them.

Vasily decided to sort the cards. To do this, he repeatedly takes the top card from the deck, and if the number on it equals the minimum number written on the cards in the deck, then he places the card away. Otherwise, he puts it under the deck and takes the next card from the top, and so on. The process ends as soon as there are no cards in the deck. You can assume that Vasily always knows the minimum number written on some card in the remaining deck, but doesn't know where this card (or these cards) is.

You are to determine the total number of times Vasily takes the top card from the deck.

## Input

The first line contains single integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100 000$) — the number of cards in the deck.

The second line contains a sequence of $*n*$ integers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ ($1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 100 000$), where $*a*_{*i*}$ is the number written on the $*i*$-th from top card in the deck.

## Output

Print the total number of times Vasily takes the top card from the deck.

## Note

In the first example Vasily at first looks at the card with number $6$ on it, puts it under the deck, then on the card with number $3$, puts it under the deck, and then on the card with number $1$. He places away the card with $1$, because the number written on it is the minimum among the remaining cards. After that the cards from top to bottom are $[2, 6, 3]$. Then Vasily looks at the top card with number $2$ and puts it away. After that the cards from top to bottom are $[6, 3]$. Then Vasily looks at card $6$, puts it under the deck, then at card $3$ and puts it away. Then there is only one card with number $6$ on it, and Vasily looks at it and puts it away. Thus, in total Vasily looks at $7$ cards.
statementZhMd:
Vasily 有一叠由 $*n*$ 张卡片组成的牌。每张卡片上都有一个整数，该整数在 $1$ 到 $100 000$（含）之间。多张卡片上写有相同的整数也是可能的。

Vasily 决定将这些卡片排序。为此，他会反复从牌堆顶端取出一张卡片：如果卡片上的数字等于牌堆中卡片所写数字的最小值，他就将这张卡片放到一旁；否则，他会将这张卡片放到牌堆底部，然后继续从顶部取下一张卡片，以此类推。当牌堆中没有卡片时，整个过程结束。你可以认为，Vasily 始终知道剩余牌堆中某张卡片上的最小数字，但不知道这张卡片（或这些卡片）位于何处。

请确定 Vasily 总共从牌堆顶端取出卡片的次数。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100 000$）——牌堆中卡片的数量。

第二行包含一个由 $*n*$ 个整数组成的序列 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$（$1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 100 000$），其中 $*a*_{*i*}$ 表示牌堆中从顶部开始第 $i$ 张卡片上的数字。

## 输出格式

输出 Vasily 总共从牌堆顶端取出卡片的次数。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，Vasily 首先查看数字为 $6$ 的卡片，并将其放到牌堆底部；然后查看数字为 $3$ 的卡片，并将其放到牌堆底部；接着查看数字为 $1$ 的卡片。由于该卡片上的数字是剩余卡片中的最小值，他将其放到一旁。此后，从顶部到底部的卡片为 $[2, 6, 3]$。接着 Vasily 查看顶部数字为 $2$ 的卡片，并将其放到一旁。此后，从顶部到底部的卡片为 $[6, 3]$。然后 Vasily 查看数字为 $6$ 的卡片，将其放到牌堆底部；接着查看数字为 $3$ 的卡片，并将其放到一旁。此时牌堆中只剩下一张数字为 $6$ 的卡片，Vasily 查看它并将其放到一旁。因此，Vasily 总共查看了 $7$ 张卡片。
